[project]
name = "fastanime"
version = "2.8.4"
description = "A browser anime site experience from the terminal"
license = "UNLICENSE"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = [
  "click>=8.1.7",
  "inquirerpy>=0.3.4",
  "pycryptodome>=3.21.0",
  "pypresence>=4.3.0",
  "requests>=2.32.3",
  "rich>=13.9.2",
  "thefuzz>=0.22.1",
  "yt-dlp[default]>=2024.10.7",
]

[project.scripts]
fastanime = 'fastanime:FastAnime'

[project.optional-dependencies]
standard = ["fastapi[standard]>=0.115.0", "mpv>=1.0.7", "plyer>=2.1.0"]
api = ["fastapi[standard]>=0.115.0"]
notifications = ["plyer>=2.1.0"]
mpv = ["mpv>=1.0.7"]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.uv]
dev-dependencies = [
  "pre-commit>=4.0.1",
  "pyinstaller>=6.11.1",
  "pyright>=1.1.384",
  "pytest>=8.3.3",
  "ruff>=0.6.9",
]

[tox]
requires =
    tox>=4
env_list = lint, pyright, py{310,311}

[testenv]
description = run unit tests
deps =uv
commands =
    uv sync --dev --all-extras
    uv run pytest

[testenv:lint]
description = run linters
skip_install = true
deps =uv
commands = 
    uv sync --dev --all-extras
    uv run ruff format .

[testenv:pyright]
description = run type checking
skip_install = true
deps =uv
commands = 
    uv sync --dev --all-extras
    uv run pyright

[SYSTEM] The command was NOT executed and the environment was not changed. Run each setup mutation, verification, or probe as a separate Action so each state-changing step can be confirmed independently.

excluded_commands.command: which uv || pip install uv (failed attempt, rejected before execution; split into separate commands)

build_recipe.rationale: The successful setup trajectory consists of two persistent state-changing commands: (1) 'pip install uv' installs the uv package manager, and (2) 'uv sync --dev --all-extras' synchronizes all project dependencies including core deps, optional extras (standard, api, notifications, mpv), and dev dependencies (pytest, ruff, pyright, etc.). The read-only inspection steps (Steps 1-3) were excluded per recipe rules. Step 4's failed command was a rejected compound of verification+mutation and is superseded by the successful Step 5. The verification_bundle confirms the test command 'uv run pytest --collect-only -q --disable-warnings' as the verified test, which should run in the fresh image. Commands are ordered as executed: uv installation precedes dependency sync.
